No we shouldn't be lenient about double-completing these promises, that would hide genuine bugs. In this case it's not a problem in itself, it's just a consequence of the actual bug:

> `java.lang.AssertionError: failure encoding chunk`

Once we've started writing a chunked response we cannot fail, because we've already sent the HTTP status code and headers.
Ah, but we do not log the exception that originally caused the failure. Without that we've no way to dig deeper really. https://github.com/elastic/elasticsearch/pull/102585 will fix that.
